summary: Review C passes Phase 1 of primary_class_session_lifetime_20261111 at 9e2bc749258cb6bc1b1fd666c104e932bb978564. The repository HEAD is daaee360d. The track files under apps/primary-advantage and packages/domain/src/student-login are identical at HEAD (git diff --stat 9e2bc7492 HEAD over those paths is empty). The API wiring is complete: the panel posts { classroomId, lifetime }, the route parses it with the domain contract, the server expiresAt reaches the panel text, and invalid_input reaches the panel as the lifetimeInvalid text in en and th. The teacher flow works for choose, start, see the expiry, end early, and restart. I found no blocking defect and six nonblocking findings (F141 to F146). F143 (a stale 3-hour sentence in the teacher manual) needs a plan line before the deploy. I confirm Review A F121, F124, and F125 as nonblocking. I did not run tests (the shell refused the vitest call); Review A ran the Green command at the same files.
nonblocking_findings: F141 (judges Review A F121, minor): from the teacher's view F121 is real but recoverable. The roster poll runs every 10 s (use-class-login.ts:7), so the option hides within 10 s after 17:00 and the state stays 'until_17'. The group then shows two options and no checked radio. New code posts 'until_17'. The server refuses before it closes the old session, so the open session stays. The teacher sees 'This choice is not available now. Choose another time.' and must pick an option. That alert also stays on screen after the teacher picks a new option, because setError(null) runs only in run() (class-session-control.tsx:66). Advice: derive the effective choice (choices.includes(lifetime) ? lifetime : '3h') and clear the error when the teacher selects an option. Not blocking.

F142 (teacher flow, minor, advice for the PM): the choice is not stored, so after a page reload the group shows '3 hours' checked while the text above says the class is open until a later date (class-session-control.tsx:59 and :111). A teacher who started '7 days' and presses New code the next day gets a new session of 3 hours. The old session closes, so every card and the class code of the class expire in 3 hours, and the students at home lose access. This follows D-5 and FR-4 (a new code uses the selected choice), so it is not a defect against the spec. The panel gives no warning. Advice: add one line near New code that says the new code starts a new session with the chosen time, or show the time of the open session. Any new text goes to the PM for the Thai check.

F143 (stale text, minor, fix before the deploy): the teacher manual says 'The class also closes by itself after 3 hours.' in messages en.json:4380 (key step4 of the startClass section), th.json:4380 ('ชั้นเรียนปิดเองหลัง 3 ชั่วโมงด้วย'), cn.json:4380, tw.json:4380, and vi.json:4229. With the new choice the sentence is wrong for 'until_17' and '7d'. The manual is outside the FR list, so the Green role did not change it. Advice: add a plan line that changes the sentence in the five files (for example 'The class also closes by itself at the time you chose.'). Put the th text into the task 1.10 hand-off for Daniel's Thai check.

F144 (accessibility, minor): the group label 'How long should sign-in stay open?' is only an aria-label (class-session-control.tsx:117). No visible text names the group, so a sighted teacher sees three radios with no heading. The 7-day help text (:132) sits outside the group and has no aria-describedby, so a screen reader user does not hear it. Advice: use a visible label (fieldset and legend, or a visible element with aria-labelledby) and aria-describedby on the group for the help text. The app has components/ui/radio-group.tsx, but the control uses native inputs. Native inputs give the arrow-key behavior for free (Ponytail rule), so the look is a question for the UX role.

F145 (strings, minor, confirms Review A F124): lifetimeHelp7d (en.json:3009, th.json:3009) says 'until this time'. Before a start, no time shows near the 7-day choice, so 'this time' has no target. After a start, the openUntil text above the group names the time. The help names cards only, but the class code stays valid for the same 7 days (D-3; this is the point of F101). en says 'End the class' where the button says 'End class'. en also shows the option as 'Until 17:00 today' and the result as 'Open until 5:00 PM' (12-hour format), two formats in one view. Advice for the PM with the Thai check: for example 'For 7 days, the class code and the cards of the class stay valid. Press End class to stop sign-in earlier.' Do not change the th text before the PM returns the check (plan task 1.10).

F146 (nit, accepted by decision F5): cn, tw, and vi hold English text for the six keys. The pages set lang={locale} at app/[locale]/layout.tsx:120, so th text is marked and correct. The English text on a cn, tw, or vi page has no lang='en' mark. This stopgap is known to the PM. Add lang='en' to those strings if a real translation does not follow soon.
evidence: Check 1, contract wiring, request: class-session-control.tsx:69 posts { classroomId, lifetime } to class-session/start. app/api/auth/student/class-session/start/route.ts:3 exports POST = startClass. handlers.ts:6-7 parses the body with sl.classSessionStartInput (contracts.ts: lifetime is z.enum 3h, until_17, 7d with default 3h) through teacherHandler, then parses the result with classSessionStartOutput. A refused value or a missing classroomId gives 400 { message: 'Invalid input' } with no code (http.ts parseBody).

Check 1, response: classSessionStartOutput has expiresAt as z.coerce.date; NextResponse.json turns the Date into an ISO string; the panel reads result.expiresAt (StartResult) and formats it in class-session-control.tsx:87-95. The roster route gives openSession.expiresAt, which uses the same formatter, so the text after a reload shows the same date.

Check 1, error path: class-session.ts:61 and :66 throw StudentLoginError('invalid_input'). http.ts:14 maps it to 400. errorResponse returns { message, code }. api.ts postStudentLogin reads the code. api.ts:89 maps status 400 plus invalid_input to 'lifetimeInvalid'. class-session-control.tsx:150 shows t('errors.lifetimeInvalid') in role=alert. en.json:2991 and th.json:2991 hold the text. A grep of invalid_input in packages/domain/src finds the code only in class-session.ts and errors.ts, so no other route reaches the lifetimeInvalid text by mistake. The panel ignores the English message of the body, so no English text leaks into th.

Check 1, route parity: grep of 'class-session/start' finds one client (class-session-control.tsx:69) and one route file. The end route and the roster route are unchanged. No second caller sends a body without lifetime, and a body without lifetime still gets '3h'.

Check 2, teacher flow: choose (native radio group, '3h' checked at first render, class-session-control.tsx:59), start (button size lg, min-h-12), see the expiry (sameBangkokDay at :87 uses calendarDayNumber with SCHOOL_TIME_ZONE; a later Bangkok date adds month and day), end early (class-session/end, unchanged), restart (New code posts the selected value). The tests pin en 'Open until Nov 18, 12:00 PM' and th '18 พ.ย. 12:00'. The text has no year, which is clear for at most 7 days. The 'until_17' hide uses minutesOfDay with Intl and SCHOOL_TIME_ZONE (:97-98), so the browser zone does not matter. Judgment of F121 is in F141. Two flow gaps are in F142 and F143.

Check 3, accessibility: radiogroup with aria-label (:117), but no visible group label (F144). Each option is a label with min-h-11 (44 px high, full width) and visible text (:119-128). Native radios with one name give arrow-key selection. The error is role=alert (:150), inserted into the page when it shows, which screen readers announce. th text is marked through the page lang (layout.tsx:120). jsdom has no layout and no key handling, so the UX role must measure the pixels and the keys.

Check 4, strings: the six keys (session.lifetimeLabel, session.lifetime.3h, .until_17, .7d, session.lifetimeHelp7d, errors.lifetimeInvalid) exist in en, th, cn, tw, and vi. en.json and th.json hold the same key order: session keys start, startHelp, codeLabel, codeAria, openUntil, openNoCode, newCode, end, lifetimeLabel, lifetime, lifetimeHelp7d; error keys signedOut, forbidden, notFound, rateLimited, unavailable, lifetimeInvalid, generic. cn, tw, and vi hold the en text for the six keys (decision F5). The en and th texts match the plan task 1.9 list. lifetimeHelp7d: see F145 (confirms F124).

Review A F125 (no panel test posts 'until_17'): confirmed as a small gap. The risk is low because the posted value is the same constant that renders the option (LIFETIME_CHOICES, class-session-control.tsx:15), and the domain and handler tests cover 'until_17'.

Review B F101 (OQ-1): not contested. From the teacher's view, the 7-day help text (F145) is the place where a code-only class warning could sit, because the roster already carries picturePasswordEnabled.

Tests: I did not run the tests. The shell refused my vitest call (permission rejected). Review A ran the Green command (domain four files, app three files) at the same files with exit 0 (app: tests_total=82, tests_failed=0). Files changed between 9e2bc7492 and HEAD under apps/primary-advantage and packages/domain/src/student-login: none.

Check 5, scope for the UX browser role (task 1.12). Setup: next build and next start of apps/primary-advantage under heavy-run.sh, a free port (never 3005 or 3099), a scratch database copy (never the shared primary_advantage), one viewport 1366x768, locales th and en, a seeded teacher and a seeded class. The real Bangkok time was 15:44 on 2026-11-11 when I wrote this, so the real 'until_17' hide is checkable after 17:00 Bangkok today without a clock override. Measure and record: (1) option_min_height_px of each label with getBoundingClientRect (44 or more), the label width, and the pixel size of the native radio input (radio_input_px); (2) the keys: Tab enters the group, ArrowDown and ArrowRight change the checked radio, a focus ring shows on the focused radio and is visible; (3) '3 hours' is checked at the first render in both locales; (4) with '7 days': the start request body keys are exactly classroomId and lifetime; the expiry text in the page equals the expiresAt of the response in Bangkok time, with the date, in en 12-hour and in th 24-hour; the help text shows only for '7 days' and its place is clear; (5) the class_start audit row in the scratch database holds lifetime=7d; (6) F142: reload the page after a 7-day start, read the checked radio and the text above, press New code, and record the new expiry; (7) F141: select 'until_17' at 16:59 (clock override with page.clock) and let the clock pass 17:00 plus the 10 s poll; record the radio state and the Start result; (8) the refusal text: route-intercept the start call with 400 { code: 'invalid_input' }, record the alert text in th and en, and that the alert stays after another option is selected; (9) the visible group label (F144): record whether any visible text names the group, with a screenshot; (10) end the class: the class code fails at the student sign-in page; (11) console errors and hydration warnings; (12) the text color contrast of the help text and the disabled state while busy. Optional second viewport 390x844: record the wrap of the label and the buttons. Screenshots go under /tmp/opencode. The evidence says automated or person-checked. Cleanup: stop the server by the pid from ss -ltnp for its port, remove the scratch database and the build output.

ratings.evidence: The request, response, and error wiring match the spec (class-session-control.tsx:69, handlers.ts:6-7, api.ts:89); the gaps are F141 and F143 at the edges.
Panel tests pin the posted body, the hide rule, the date text, and the refusal text (class-session-control.test.tsx), but no panel test posts 'until_17' (Review A F125).
git diff --name-only shows only the Red and Green paths and the five message files (decision F5); the stale manual sentence in F143 stayed untouched.
Every finding has a file:line, but I did not run the tests (the shell refused the vitest call) and I did not use a browser.
